scientific_authority: the deterministic executable state and update law in mechanism.py
mechanism_name: final-norm-gain coupled to clipped-Adam recovery oscillator

required_gfg_inputs: materialized transformer.ln_f.weight parameter versions through the cut
gradient_clip occurrence total_norm payloads through the cut

state_variables.gain_l2: L2 norm of the exact current final-layer-normalization gain tensor; formation coordinate
state_variables.last_burst_step: start of the latest observed clipped-gradient relaxation burst
state_variables.last_burst_period: latest observed interval between burst starts
state_variables.resonance_used: whether a prolonged high-gain recovery episode was already observed
state_variables.observed_transition_step: exact prefix transition, or null when formation remains in the future

update_law.gain: g(d)=g_cut+0.0043*d+(r_cut-0.0043)*2000*(1-exp(-d/2000)); r_cut blends the prefix slope with 0.0043+0.0034*exp(-max(0,g_cut-14.4)/12)
update_law.high_gain_resonance: the first burst at gain_rms>=6.995 has a 300-step recovery and a minimum 600-step recharge

prefix_conditioning.gain_rate: 25 percent robust median prefix rate plus 75 percent state-dependent structural rate, bounded to reject one-burst outliers
prefix_conditioning.oscillator_phase: latest burst start and latest observed burst interval
prefix_conditioning.gain_scale: exact prefix tensor norm and its element count

operational_use_audit.gain_l2: changes gain_at, rule_strength, transition intervals, curve, and resonance timing
operational_use_audit.gain_rate_l2_per_step: changes every future gain and therefore transition and curve
operational_use_audit.last_burst_step: changes projected pulse phase and instability timing
operational_use_audit.last_burst_period: changes the next pulse and all subsequent pulse times
operational_use_audit.recovery_load: records active prefix recovery; active last_burst_step executes its effect in the first forecast
operational_use_audit.resonance_used: suppresses a second prolonged recovery episode
operational_use_audit.recent_evaluations: diagnostic only and not claimed as operative state

transport_claim: The functional form is structural; tensor scale, rate and oscillator phase are reinitialized from each supplied prefix. Discovery-estimated constants remain prospective hypotheses, not proven cross-run invariants.
